Stop a long fit from starting in an interactive session

Source: R/long-fit.R
guard_long_fit.Rd

A template calls this just before an expensive cache_fit(). In an interactive session (the console, or running chunks one by one) with no cached result yet, it stops and says to run the job with submit_job instead, because a fit that runs for hours dies with the session. A render, a cached result, or options(hvtiRtemplates.allow_interactive_fit = TRUE) lets it pass.

Usage

guard_long_fit(name, dir, why, refit = FALSE)

Arguments

name

Character(1). The cache_fit() name; the cache file is <dir>/<name>.rds.

dir

Character(1). The cache_fit() directory.

why

Character(1). Why the fit is long, shown in the error.

refit

Logical(1). TRUE when the job will recompute the fit even though a cached file exists (the template's REFIT); the cached file then does not make the call safe, so it is refused too.

Value

invisible(FALSE) when the fit may proceed; otherwise an error.

Examples

guard_long_fit("example-fit", dir = tempdir(), why = "it takes hours")
